entities.name: Jenrik
entities.description: A mysterious astronomancer who lived in a tall tower on Innistrad and studied the stars; he died trapped in the walls of Markov Manor.

entities.name: Nephalia
entities.description: A province of Innistrad containing the Silver Beach.

entities.name: Silver Beach
entities.description: A beach in Nephalia where Jenrik's tower stood.

entities.name: Jenrik's Tower
entities.description: A tall tower on the Silver Beach whose mortar was mixed with glittering sand.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: A moonfolk planeswalker, the only person welcomed by Jenrik.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A vampire of Markov Manor whom Jenrik went to question.

entities.name: Markov Manor
entities.description: The castle where Jenrik was trapped in the walls.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who later found Tamiyo's journal in Jenrik's petrified hands.

entities.name: Vadrik
entities.description: Jenrik's old friend and colleague who took up his work.

events.summary: Tamiyo spent months studying Jenrik's charts and adding her observations.
events.quote: She spent months poring over his countless charts and adding her observations.

events.summary: At Tamiyo's urging, Jenrik went to Markov Manor to question Sorin Markov; he and the vampires were trapped in the walls.
events.quote: someone ripped the castle apart and trapped the vampires and Jenrik in the walls

events.summary: Jace Beleren pried Tamiyo's journal from Jenrik's petrified hands.
events.quote: Jace Beleren later found Tamiyo's journal, and pried it from Jenrik's petrified hands.

events.summary: Vadrik took up Jenrik's work after his death.
events.quote: his old friend and colleague Vadrik took up the burden of his work

relations.quote: living in a tall tower on the Silver Beach of Innistrad's province of Nephalia
The only person welcomed by Jenrik was the moonfolk planeswalker Tamiyo
his old friend and colleague Vadrik
